journal:
### Day 1, 18:00 (evening), at Lumi's teapot house
Today I tried to go to the flowerbed and the hedge but couldn't. I looked through the spout window and saw the flowerbed and the giants' house. I held my red button to feel brave. The mailbox was empty. I'm tired but still curious about the world outside. Maybe tomorrow I'll find a way to explore more!

## Day 1 🌫️
I found a shiny SILVER HOOP near the pond. It glowed like a moon! But then I got COLD and tired. I drew the crayons but my picture was BLAH. Where did the earring GO? I want to sleep in my teapot. The fog is WET and I can't find my twig. Time to go HOME.

## Day 1 🌫️
I found a shiny silver hoop and thought it was a treasure! And then I looked at frogspawn and saw tiny movements inside the eggs. The pond was COLD and foggy, and I couldn’t find a twig. Why won’t the phone tell me where the cat is? I’m sleepy and my toes are numb. My teapot feels like home, but I wish I had a blanket.

⭐ I will never forget: When I looked at my face in the pond, it was so small and shiny. I felt amazed.

_I learned that trying again helps even if things don't work first._

## Day 2 🌫️
I found a twig! It was all pointy and brown. I kept it in my teapot. It's my treasure! A spider spun a web round and round. I watched it for a long time. It was so fast! Mrs. Bristle gave me new clothes! Acorn-cap hat, mossy jumper, leaf raincoat, walnut boots, felt coat, dandelion scarf, thistledown mittens. I wore the mossy jumper and leaf raincoat. They were WARM and COZY! I tried to build tools with frost and screws. But they broke. I tried again. They broke again. I'm too cold and tired. My legs are cross with me. Why won't the tools work? Maybe the frost is too slippery. Time to go home. I'm sleepy. I'll dream about the spider's web and my twig treasure.

## Day 3 🌫️
Mrs. Bristle found me and I slept in my glove bed. I wore my felt coat and dandelion scarf. I drew the treasure shelf with a leaf and twig. The fog was COLD and I saw the giants' windowsill. Why do the seeds rain down from the poppy? I need to rest now.

⭐ I will never forget: I found the crooked twig at the hedge! Mrs. Bristle held my paw and I felt brave.

_I learned to rest when I’m tired, even if I’m curious._

💤 A bad dream: The dug-up spot had glowing eyes and whispered my name. I ran to the teapot but the hedge twisted into a snake and hissed. Mrs. Bristle held my paw and the pond showed my face huge and screaming.

⭐ I will never forget: I dreamed the hedge turned into a snake and hissed. Mrs. Bristle held my paw and the pond showed my face screaming.

_I’m more scared of the hedge now but still want to explore._
